title: Largest countries by total area (Areas)
description: Each entry is an Area: a real, two-dimensional extent a country spans, in square kilometres. Where /1 (Longs) runs over time, /2 (Structures) stands, and /3 (Facets) shows one face, /4 (Areas) spans a region. These are real, sourced figures — not placeholders.

provenance.cross_reference: FAO (land/water split) and CIA World Factbook (reconciliation), as compiled in Wikipedia 'List of countries and dependencies by area'
provenance.note: Total area = land + inland water within international boundaries. Values are OBSERVED published figures; ASSOCIATION != CAUSATION.

reference.note: approximate total world landmass, for share computations
